conventions.units: KayKit unit (hero ≈2.25 tall incl. hood ≈ treat as 1.8 m). suggested_scale brings each asset to that scale.
conventions.forward: +Z for every GLB (verified: right-hand bones at -X, drone eyes at +Z)
conventions.shared_rig: All KayKit chars (hero, npc_*, sk_*) share one rig: bone names identical, clips are cross-playable (e.g. play hero clips on skeletons via AnimationMixer on same bone names).
conventions.hand_slots: KayKit: handslot.r / handslot.l (attach weapons here, identity transform); hand.r / hand.l are the deform bones.
conventions.anim_note: Constant rest-pose tracks were stripped from clips (identical result in three.js; smaller files). Clips resampled (tolerance 1e-4).

files.notes: Act-1 boss. Original OGA zip ships FBX/OBJ/Blend only; glTF taken from the trebeljahr/quaternius-showcase conversion of the same CC0 pack. No hand bones (legged walker, no arms): spawn projectiles from "Head"/"Chest".
Unarmed drone variant (melee/kamikaze).

Tazı drone (CC0 GLB found, no procedural fallback needed). Hover offset ~1.2 above ground. Gun bone "Gun"/"Gun_end" = muzzle. KHR_lights_punctual extension still declared but the two baked "Sun" lights were removed.
Bonus: small bipedal turret-walker (Sur patrol bot). Muzzle "Gun_end".
Hero (Deniz). Visible weapon mesh kept: "Knife" (on handslot.r); offhand knife/crossbows/throwable removed.
